statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The value is directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. No combination of elements was required. The supplementary tables contain additional detail on operating leases and parent company cash flows but do not provide a further breakdown of the depreciation and amortization figure itself.
